subject: Offer exception request — Staff Inference (Ethan Zhou) — comp + retention bundle
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer exception request — Ethan Zhou (Staff Inference)

Mina — attaching a short summary + candidate resume and competitive comp matrix. Need an exception decision today if possible.

TL;DR:
- Candidate: Ethan Zhou (ex-Scale, senior infra + inference lead)
- Role: Staff Inference Engineer (IC, reporting to Markus)
- Problem: Counteroffer from current employer surfaced this morning. Candidate expects base increase + a sign-on to waive the counter.
- Ask: Approve out-of-band base to $225,000 (band cap $200,000), 30k one-time sign-on (taxed as bonus), and a 0.25% equity refresh (accelerated vesting schedule: 50% at 6 months).

Why we need it: Ethan has rare production inference + kernel optimization experience we can't easily backfill. Markus and I both believe losing him will delay the LLM runtime roadmap by a quarter.

Attachments: offer-comparison.xlsx (comp comparisons + market data), ethan_zhou_resume.pdf, proposed-offer-terms.docx

Requested approvals: comp exception (base + sign-on), equity refresh (one-time grant), and permission to include accelerated partial vesting in the offer as a retention mechanism.

If you want a tighter alternative, Rishi suggested a performance-based retention tranche (see attached). I'm happy to field any questions — candidate is on a week-long notice window; they expect an answer by EOD Friday PT.

— Priya
Recruiter, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0103

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer exception request — Ethan Zhou (Staff Inference)

Mina — quick note in support.

Ethan is the single best candidate we've seen for the Staff inference hire: production rollout experience with long-context models, custom kernel work, and real-world batching strategies. Losing him means pushing the new runtime benchmarks and customer pilots later.

I'm comfortable with the numbers Priya proposed. If we must compromise: reduce base to $215k and keep the $30k sign-on. But the equity refresh (0.25%) is important to secure him long-term. I will own a 6-month performance check and report back.

Please let me know if we can get this over the line — I will prioritize his onboarding schedule for November.

— Markus
VP, Inference Engineering

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer exception request — Ethan Zhou (Staff Inference)

Thanks for the context. Finance can support a partial exception subject to documentation.

Approved today: one-time sign-on of $30,000 and a special equity refresh of 0.15% (grant now, vesting accelerated 25% at 6 months) provided the hiring manager commits to the 6-month retention review and provides a short success metrics doc.

Not approved today: raising base above band cap. If you need the higher base, provide a short business case with expected impact to customer milestones and a contra-budget plan (where we offset the incremental salary).

Please route the final terms through me so payroll/tax can be prepped.

— Laura
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer exception request — Ethan Zhou (Staff Inference)

Appreciate the urgency. A couple of thoughts to keep total comp aligned while giving the candidate security:

1) Keep base at $205k (band + small uplift) and move the delta into a guaranteed, prorated retention bonus payable at 6 months ($15k) + $30k sign-on today. This reduces recurring comp pressure but still nets the candidate higher cash in the near-term.
2) Increase the equity refresh to 0.25% but split vesting: 50% at 6 months (retention), 50% over the normal schedule. That signals commitment without permanently inflating bands.

If Markus is confident the candidate will materially shorten feature delivery timelines, I can support a one-time base uplift for this role, but I need the documented milestones and an approval from Exec Compensation for precedent.

— Rishi
Compensation Partner

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Offer exception request — Ethan Zhou (Staff Inference)

Thanks team — here's the decision after weighing risk and precedents: APPROVED with conditions.

Final approved package (exception):
- Base: $210,000 (one-time uplift above band cap; no band reset)
- Sign-on: $30,000 (paid within first payroll cycle)
- Equity refresh: 0.20% one-time grant; vesting: 50% at 6 months, remainder per standard schedule
- Additional: $15,000 retention bonus payable at 6 months conditional on manager sign-off of agreed milestones (Markus to provide milestones doc within 48 hours)

Conditions:
1) Markus to share a 1‑page success metrics doc (deliverables + impact) and confirm start date by Monday.
2) Legal to include the 6-month accelerated vesting clause and retention bonus language in the offer; payroll to confirm tax handling for sign-on.
3) This approval is non-precedential and will be logged with Exec Compensation for record-keeping.

Priya — proceed to send the updated offer terms to the candidate and upload the final doc to the Drive link in my earlier note. Copy Laura for payroll coordination.

— Mina
Head of Talent Operations

From: Ethan Zhou <ethan.zhou@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_naranjan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Oct 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer — Staff Inference (Redwood Inference)

Hi Priya / Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround and transparency. I reviewed the updated terms this afternoon and I confirm I will accept the offer as outlined.

A couple of quick asks: can the sign-on be grossed up to account for my expected tax bracket? Also, please confirm the 6-month retention bonus mechanics in writing. Otherwise I'm happy to sign.

Looking forward to joining and partnering with Markus on the runtime work.

Best,
Ethan
